fields.label: Time zone
fields.description: Used for reminders, birthdays and every other schedule. Changes apply from the next run of each schedule.

fields.label: Embed colour
fields.description: Colour of the bot's informational embeds. Empty uses the default blurple.

fields.label: Custom command prefix
fields.description: Members run custom commands as <prefix>name, e.g. !rules. Empty (or "off") turns prefix commands off; /tag use still works.
fields.patternMessage: The prefix can be at most 5 characters, without spaces or any of ` < > @ # : \ /.

generalGroups.title: Timezone roles
generalGroups.description: Roles such as @CST that give members a time zone in /timestamp (/settings timezone-role).

fields.label: Timezone roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles get its time zone in /timestamp, unless they saved their own with /timezone set; with several, the highest role wins. Hand the roles out with a Unique reaction-role panel.

fields.label: Moderation log channel
fields.description: Every case (warn, timeout, kick, ban, ...) is posted here, even while the Audit Logs module is off. Empty turns case logging off.

fields.label: DM members when punished
fields.description: Members get a direct message when they are warned, timed out, kicked or banned.

fields.label: Command visibility
fields.description: Who sees the confirmation of a moderation command.

fields.label: Moderator roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles can use the bot's moderator commands.

fields.label: Immune roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles are never punished by the bot or by Auto-Moderation.

fields.label: Mute role
fields.description: Used for mutes longer than 28 days (Discord timeouts cover the rest). /modconfig muterole setup:true creates one and locks it out of every channel.

fields.label: Warning escalation
fields.description: Punishes a member automatically once they collect a number of warnings (optionally within a time window).

itemFields.label: Warnings
itemFields.description: How many warnings trigger this step.

itemFields.label: Within (seconds)
itemFields.description: Only warnings from this many seconds count. Empty counts every warning.

itemFields.label: Duration (seconds)
itemFields.description: Required for Timeout (at most 28 days) and Temporary ban; optional for Mute; not used for Kick and Ban.

automod.title: Bad words
automod.description: Removes or punishes messages with words you do not want in the server.

fields.label: Bad Words
fields.description: Removes messages that contain a listed word, phrase or pattern.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Bad words and phrases
fields.description: Whole words or phrases, matched case-insensitively (also through spacing and markdown tricks).

fields.label: Bad word patterns
fields.description: Regular expressions (case-insensitive) for words the list cannot catch. Unsafe or catch-all patterns are refused.

fields.label: Server Invites
fields.description: Catches invite links to other Discord servers.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: External Links
fields.description: Catches links that are blocked, or not allowed when no domain is blocked.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Blocked domains
fields.description: Links to these sites are caught. While this list is empty, every link outside the allowed domains is caught.

fields.label: Allowed domains
fields.description: Links to these sites are always fine. Adding a domain to one list takes it off the other.

fields.label: Anti-Spam
fields.description: Catches members who send messages too fast.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 3 to 30 messages within 5 s.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Repeated Text
fields.description: Catches the same message sent over and over.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 2 to 20 identical messages within 30 s.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Excessive Caps
fields.description: Catches messages that are mostly capital letters.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 50 to 100 % capitals, messages with at least 10 letters.
fields.unit: % capitals, messages with at least 10 letters

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Excessive Emojis
fields.description: Catches messages with too many emojis.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 1 to 50 emojis.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Excessive Spoilers
fields.description: Catches messages with too many spoiler tags or spoiler attachments.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 1 to 50 spoilers.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Excessive Mentions
fields.description: Catches messages that ping too many members or roles.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 2 to 50 mentions.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

fields.label: Zalgo
fields.description: Catches glitch text with piles of combining marks.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Triggers at 3 to 20 stacked combining marks.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

options.label: Every role except the listed ones
Every channel except the listed ones

automod.title: Honeypot
automod.description: Works even while every rule is off, and an exempt channel does not shield it.

fields.label: Honeypot channels
fields.description: Trap channels nobody should type in. Spam bots and hacked accounts post everywhere, so whoever posts in one is punished at once. Staff and exempt roles are never caught. /automod honeypot add can create the channel and post a warning in it.

fields.label: Action
fields.description: Softban and ban also delete their messages from the last day in every channel.

fields.label: Timeout length (seconds)
fields.description: How long "Delete & timeout" times the member out (1 minute to 28 days).

automod.title: Exemptions
automod.description: Staff (moderators, Manage Messages and immune roles) are always exempt.

fields.label: Exempt roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles are never checked by any rule.

fields.label: Exempt channels
fields.description: Messages in these channels (or categories) are never checked.

logging.title: Log channels
logging.description: Each kind of event goes to its own channel. Empty turns that kind off.

fields.label: Message log
fields.description: Deleted, edited and bulk-deleted messages, and posted invites.

fields.label: Member log
fields.description: Role, nickname, avatar and timeout changes, bans and unbans.

fields.label: Server log
fields.description: Channels, threads, roles, emojis, invites and server edits.

fields.label: Voice log
fields.description: Members joining, leaving and switching voice channels.

fields.label: Joins & leaves log
fields.description: Members joining and leaving the server.

fields.label: Logged events
fields.description: Checked events are logged. Unchecked ones are not.

fields.label: Ignored channels
fields.description: Message events in these channels are never logged. A category covers its channels and threads.

welcome.title: Welcome message
welcome.description: Posted in a channel when someone joins.

fields.label: Welcome message in a channel
fields.description: Posts the welcome message in the welcome channel when someone joins.

fields.label: Welcome channel
fields.description: Where the welcome message and card are posted.

fields.label: Welcome message as an embed
fields.description: Sends the channel welcome as an embed; off sends plain text.

fields.label: Message text
fields.description: The text line (pings work here). Leave it empty to send only the embed.

fields.label: Embed
fields.description: Shown when "Welcome message as an embed" is on. Clear it to use the default embed.

default.title: 👋 Welcome to {server}!
default.description: You are our **{server.member_count.ordinal}** member. Enjoy your stay!

welcome.title: Welcome card
welcome.description: An image with the member's avatar and name, attached to the welcome message.

fields.label: Welcome card
fields.description: Whether the card is sent, and its colours and background.

fields.label: Send a welcome card
fields.description: Attaches the welcome card image to the welcome message.

fields.label: Background colour
fields.description: Empty uses the default background.

fields.label: Background image
fields.description: An http(s) link to a PNG, JPEG or WebP image (at most 5 MB). The bot downloads it once to check it.

fields.label: Overlay opacity
fields.description: How much the background image is darkened (0 to 1). Empty uses the default.

welcome.title: Welcome DM
welcome.description: A private message to every new member.

fields.label: Welcome DM
fields.description: Also sends new members a private welcome message.

fields.label: DM text
fields.description: Leave it empty to send only the embed.
fields.default: Have a great time here in **{server}**!

fields.label: DM embed
fields.description: Optional. Clear it to send the text only.

fields.label: Welcome card in the DM
fields.description: Attaches the welcome card image to the welcome DM.

welcome.title: Goodbye message
welcome.description: Posted in a channel when a member leaves.

fields.label: Goodbye message
fields.description: Posts a message in the goodbye channel when a member leaves.

fields.label: Goodbye channel
fields.description: Where the goodbye message is posted.

fields.label: Goodbye message as an embed
fields.description: Sends the goodbye message as an embed; off sends plain text.

fields.label: Message text
fields.description: The text line. Leave it empty to send only the embed.

fields.label: Embed
fields.description: Shown when "Goodbye message as an embed" is on. Clear it to use the default embed.

fields.label: Autoroles
fields.description: Given to every member who joins (after verification and Rules Screening). Roles must be below the bot's highest role.

fields.label: Delay (seconds)
fields.description: Wait this long after the join before giving the autoroles (0 = immediately, at most 7 days). Members already waiting keep their time.

captcha.title: Verification
captcha.description: Post or move the verification panel with /captcha setup or /captcha channel in Discord.

fields.label: Verified role
fields.description: Given to members who pass. It cannot be a moderator, immune or mute role.

fields.label: Required roles
fields.description: Members need any one of these before Verify works (a Linked Role fits). Empty means no requirement. Pick the fallback form with /captcha require in Discord.

fields.label: Captcha type
fields.description: Image: type the code from a picture. Button: one click.

fields.label: Kick unverified members after (minutes)
fields.description: 0 never kicks; otherwise 5 to 10080 minutes (7 days). Setting 0 cancels the kicks already scheduled.

captcha.title: Verification panel
captcha.description: The message with the Verify button. Saving here also updates the posted panel.

fields.label: Panel message

embed.title: 🛡️ Verification required
embed.description:
Welcome to **{server}**!

To make sure you are human, press **Verify** below. Once you pass, you get access to the rest of the server.

footer.text: Only you can see your captcha.

fields.description: Text, embed and link buttons of the panel. {user} tokens stay as they are: the panel has no member.

fields.label: Verify button
fields.description: Label and colour of the button that starts the verification.

leveling.title: XP
leveling.description: Members earn a random amount of XP per message, at most once per cooldown.

fields.label: Minimum XP per message
fields.description: MEE6 uses 15.

fields.label: Maximum XP per message
fields.description: MEE6 uses 25. Must be at least the minimum.

fields.label: Cooldown (seconds)
fields.description: Messages within this time after the last rewarded one earn nothing.

fields.label: Server XP multiplier
fields.description: Multiplies every XP gain (0.1 to 10).

fields.label: Announce level-ups
fields.description: Where the level-up message goes.

fields.label: Announcement channel
fields.description: Used when "Custom channel" is selected.

fields.label: Level-up message as an embed
fields.description: Sends level-up announcements as an embed; off sends plain text.

fields.label: Level-up message
fields.description: Empty uses the default message.
fields.default: GG {player}, you just advanced to level {level}!

fields.label: Voice XP
fields.description: Members also earn XP for time spent in voice channels (not while alone, muted or AFK). Switching it off drops open voice sessions without credit.

fields.label: XP per minute in voice
fields.description: How much XP a minute in voice is worth.

fields.label: No-XP roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles earn no XP.

fields.label: No-XP channels
fields.description: No XP is earned in these channels, their threads, or the channels of a listed category.

leveling.title: Role rewards behaviour
leveling.description: Pick the reward roles themselves in the list below. Run /levelconfig role sync in Discord to apply a change to every member.

fields.label: Keep lower reward roles
fields.description: Members keep earlier reward roles when they earn a higher one; off keeps only the highest.

fields.label: Remove rewards on XP loss
fields.description: Members who lose XP also lose the reward roles above their new level.

fields.label: XP boost roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles earn more XP; the highest multiplier applies.

fields.label: Rank card
fields.description: Colours and background of the /rank card.

fields.label: Background image
fields.description: An http(s) link to an image (at most 8 MB). The bot downloads it once to check it.

fields.label: Overlay opacity
fields.description: How much the background image is darkened (0 to 0.9).

fields.label: Auto-responder triggers
fields.description: Replies automatically when a message matches one of your triggers (needs the Custom Commands module on).

fields.label: Category for new stat channels
fields.description: New statistics channels are created in this category (the bot needs Manage Channels there). Empty creates them at the top.

fields.label: Announcement channel
fields.description: Where birthdays are announced. Empty turns announcements off.

fields.label: Announcement hour
fields.description: The hour (0-23) in the server time zone when birthdays are announced.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Used when the birth year is unknown. Empty uses the default.

fields.label: Message with age
fields.description: Used when the birth year is known. Empty uses the default.

fields.label: Birthday role
fields.description: Given for the member's birthday and removed the next day. Changing it here does not take the old role off members celebrating today; /birthday config role in Discord does.

fields.label: Require birth year
fields.description: Members must include the year when they save their birthday.

achievements.title: Unlock announcements
achievements.description: Create and edit the achievements themselves in the list below.

fields.label: Announce unlocks
fields.description: Where unlocks are announced. Boosts and purchases have no channel of their own and use the announcement channel.

fields.label: Announcement channel
fields.description: Used by "Custom channel", and for unlocks that happen outside a channel.

fields.label: Announcement as an embed
fields.description: Sends achievement unlock announcements as an embed; off sends plain text.

fields.label: Announcement message
fields.description: Empty uses the default message.

fields.label: Currency name
fields.description: Shown after every amount, e.g. "250 coins".
fields.patternMessage: Use letters, numbers, spaces and simple punctuation only (no markdown, mentions or newlines).

fields.label: Currency emoji
fields.description: A standard emoji or a custom emoji of this server.

fields.label: Starting balance
fields.description: What a brand-new account starts with. At most the maximum balance.

fields.label: Maximum balance
fields.description: No account can hold more. Lowering it also lowers every balance above the new maximum.

fields.label: Maximum bet
fields.description: The highest bet of a casino game. 0 = no limit beyond the balance.

fields.label: Maximum winnings
fields.description: The highest net win of one casino game. 0 = no limit.

fields.label: Copy the legacy global balance
fields.description: New accounts start once with the member's balance from the old global wallet.

fields.label: Minimum daily reward
fields.description: The smallest /daily payout.

fields.label: Maximum daily reward
fields.description: The largest /daily payout. At least the minimum.

fields.label: Minimum work pay
fields.description: The smallest /work payout.

fields.label: Maximum work pay
fields.description: The largest /work payout. At least the minimum.

fields.label: Work cooldown (minutes)
fields.description: How long a member waits between two /work.

fields.label: Casino games are allowed
fields.description: With an empty list the games work everywhere.

fields.label: Channels
fields.description: Threads count as their parent channel.

fields.label: /search urban only in age-restricted channels
fields.description: Urban Dictionary lookups only work in age-restricted channels.

liverole.title: Live role
liverole.description: Changes here apply as members start or stop streaming. /liverole set and require in Discord also update current streamers at once.

fields.label: Live role
fields.description: Given while a member streams. Use a role only the bot hands out: members without a stream lose it.

fields.label: Only for members with
fields.description: Only members with this role get the live role. Empty = everyone who streams.

liverole.title: Go-live posts
liverole.description: Posted when a member goes live and gets the live role, at most once an hour per member. Only the ping role is notified.

fields.label: Post channel
fields.description: Where go-live posts go. Empty turns them off.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: {url} is the stream link. Empty uses the default.

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Mentioned at the start of each post. It only pings if the role is mentionable or the bot has Mention Everyone.

counting.title: Counting channel
counting.description: A new channel starts from 1 at the next count. /counting set in Discord also posts the rules there.

fields.label: Counting channel
fields.description: Members count up here, one number per message.

autotime.title: Ignored channels
autotime.description: Times are read in the zone of the member who typed them: their own (/timezone set) or their timezone role.

fields.label: Ignored channels
fields.description: Times typed in these channels are never answered. A category covers its channels and threads.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: /suggestion submit posts here; members vote with the buttons and staff review with /suggestion.

fields.label: Suggestion channel
fields.description: New suggestions are posted here with voting buttons.

fields.label: Open a thread on each suggestion
fields.description: Starts a discussion thread on every new suggestion (the bot needs Create Public Threads).

fields.label: Allow anonymous suggestions
fields.description: Members may hide their name on a suggestion. Staff can still look up who wrote it.

fields.label: DM the author on review
fields.description: The author gets a direct message when staff approve, deny or otherwise update their suggestion.

fields.label: Cooldown between suggestions
fields.description: Seconds a member waits between two suggestions. 0 = no cooldown.

modmail.title: Modmail
modmail.description: Members DM the bot; each conversation opens a thread in the staff channel. Block members with /modmail block.

fields.label: Staff channel
fields.description: Conversations open as threads here. Keep it hidden from members; the bot needs Create Private Threads.

fields.label: Roles to ping
fields.description: Pinged in the new thread when a conversation opens.

fields.label: Greeting
fields.description: Sent to the member when their conversation opens.
fields.default: Thanks for your message! The staff of **{server}** will answer you here soon.

fields.label: Anonymous staff replies
fields.description: Replies reach the member as "Staff" instead of the name of the staff member.

afk.title: AFK
afk.description: Members go AFK with /afk set; it clears on their next message.

fields.label: Add [AFK] to nicknames
fields.description: Puts "[AFK] " in front of the nickname while a member is AFK (the bot needs Manage Nicknames).

fields.label: Ignored channels
fields.description: Messages here neither end an AFK nor answer mentions of AFK members. A category covers its channels.

antiraid.title: Raid detection
antiraid.description: A raid is this many joins within this many seconds.

fields.label: Joins
fields.description: How many joins in the window count as a raid.

fields.label: Window
fields.description: The window the joins are counted in.

fields.label: Members who join during a raid
fields.description: What happens to members who join while a raid lockdown lasts.

fields.label: Alert channel
fields.description: Raid alerts go here. Empty uses the moderation log channel.

antiraid.title: Lockdown
antiraid.description: What the bot does while a raid lasts. /antiraid lockdown starts or ends one by hand.

fields.label: Pause invites
fields.description: Pauses every invite while the lockdown lasts (the bot needs Manage Server).

fields.label: Lock chat
fields.description: Takes Send Messages from @everyone while the lockdown lasts and gives it back afterwards (the bot needs Manage Roles).

fields.label: Lockdown length
fields.description: The lockdown lifts itself after this long.

fields.label: Minimum account age
fields.description: Accounts younger than this get the action below. 0 = off.

fields.label: Action for new accounts
fields.description: What happens to accounts younger than the minimum age when they join.

fields.label: Announcement channel
fields.description: Where /event create posts. Empty posts in the channel the command runs in.

fields.label: Also create a Discord event
fields.description: Adds each event to the Events list of the server too (the bot needs Manage Events).

fields.label: Reminder
fields.description: Minutes before the start to ping members who are going. 0 = no reminder.

events.title: Event channels
events.description: Private text and voice channels for each new event. Only members who answer Going or Maybe, the host and administrators can see them. The bot needs Manage Channels and Manage Roles.

fields.label: Create channels for events
fields.description: A text chat when the event is created and a voice channel before it starts. When the event is over and the voice channel is empty, both are deleted, along with the event post and its reminders.

fields.label: Category
fields.description: Where the channels go. Empty uses a category called Events and makes it if needed.

fields.label: Open the voice channel early
fields.description: Minutes before the start. 0 = at the start.

rolepersist.title: Role persistence
rolepersist.description: Roles with powerful permissions, managed roles and roles above the bot are never given back.

fields.label: Give back nicknames
fields.description: Also restores the nickname a member had when they left.

fields.label: Never give back
fields.description: These roles are not saved when a member leaves.

fields.label: Keep for
fields.description: Saved roles of members who left longer ago than this are dropped.

fields.label: Thank-you channel
fields.description: A thank-you is posted here when a member boosts the server. Empty = none.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.description: Posted when a member starts boosting.
fields.default: 💎 {user} just boosted **{server}**! Thank you! We now have {boosts} boosts.

boosts.title: Booster roles
boosts.description: Boosters make a role of their own with /boost role. Booster roles never get any permissions.

fields.label: Let boosters make their own role
fields.description: Boosters can create a role with their own name, colour and icon (the bot needs Manage Roles).

fields.label: Place booster roles below
fields.description: Booster roles go just below this role. Empty = just above the Nitro Booster role (or at the bottom), so moderators keep power over boosters.

fields.label: Keep the role after a boost ends
fields.description: Days a member keeps their role after they stop boosting. 0 = removed at once.

backups.title: Automatic backups
backups.description: Make, restore and download backups with /backup. Only the server owner can restore or delete a backup.

fields.label: Back up every
fields.description: Hours between automatic backups. 0 = off.

fields.label: Automatic backups kept
fields.description: When a new automatic backup would go over this, the oldest one is deleted.

confessions.title: Confessions
confessions.description: Members confess with /confession submit. Staff never see who wrote one; only admins can reveal an author with /confession reveal, and that is written to the moderation log.

fields.label: Confession channel
fields.description: Confessions are posted here.

fields.label: Review channel
fields.description: Confessions wait here for a moderator to approve them. Empty = posted at once. Keep it hidden from members.

fields.label: Allow an image
fields.description: Members may attach one image to a confession.

fields.label: Refuse links
fields.description: Confessions that contain a link are refused.

fields.label: Cooldown between confessions
fields.description: Seconds a member waits between two confessions. 0 = no cooldown.

autothreads.title: Auto threads
autothreads.description: Every member message in these channels gets its own thread (the bot needs Create Public Threads).

fields.label: Channels
fields.description: Thread names may use {user} (display name), {content} (the start of the message), {channel} and {date}.

itemFields.label: Close button
itemFields.description: Posts a button in each thread that its starter or a moderator can use to close it.

fields.label: Announcement channels
fields.description: New posts here, by members, bots or webhooks, are published to the servers that follow the channel (the bot needs Manage Messages). Discord allows 10 per channel per hour; the rest stay unpublished.

voiceroles.title: Voice roles
voiceroles.description: Use roles made only for this: the bot takes them away from anyone who is not in a linked voice channel.

fields.label: Channel roles
fields.description: Members in the channel, or in any voice channel of the category, have the role.

fields.label: Roles for any voice channel
fields.description: Members in any voice channel of the server have these roles.

fields.label: None in the AFK channel
fields.description: Members in the server's AFK channel get no voice roles.

bumps.title: Bump reminders
bumps.description: Works with Disboard: the bot sees each successful /bump and reminds the server when it can bump again.

fields.label: Reminder channel
fields.description: Reminders are posted here. Empty = the channel of the last bump.

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Pinged with each reminder. Empty = no ping.

fields.label: Reminder message
fields.description: Posted when the server can be bumped again.
fields.default: 📣 The server can be bumped again! Use `/bump` to keep us near the top of Disboard.

fields.label: Thank the bumper
fields.description: Replies with a thank-you right after a successful bump.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.description: Sent after each successful bump.
fields.default: 📣 Thanks for bumping, {user}! The next bump is possible {next}.

fields.label: Coins per bump
fields.description: Coins given for each bump while Economy is on. 0 = none.

notExposed.levelingEnabled: deprecated and never read (xpEnabled is the Levels flag)
notExposed.xpRate: legacy: only the migration to xpMin/xpMax read it
notExposed.captchaChannelId: changes only together with the posted panel: /captcha setup or /captcha channel posts it
notExposed.captchaMessageId: bot-managed: the id of the posted verification panel
notExposed.captchaFallbackFormId: an application form id, picked by name with /captcha require form (no form picker here)
notExposed.modmailBlockedUserIds: a list of members: /modmail block and unblock manage it
notExposed.confessionBlockedUserIds: secret: blocked by confession number so staff never learn who wrote it (/confession block)

DEFAULT_TEXTS.welcomeDmMessage: Have a great time here in **{server}**!
DEFAULT_TEXTS.levelUpMessage: GG {player}, you just advanced to level {level}!
DEFAULT_TEXTS.modmailGreeting: Thanks for your message! The staff of **{server}** will answer you here soon.
DEFAULT_TEXTS.boostMessage: 💎 {user} just boosted **{server}**! Thank you! We now have {boosts} boosts.
DEFAULT_TEXTS.bumpReminderMessage: 📣 The server can be bumped again! Use `/bump` to keep us near the top of Disboard.
DEFAULT_TEXTS.bumpThanksMessage: 📣 Thanks for bumping, {user}! The next bump is possible {next}.

welcomeEmbed.title: 👋 Welcome to {server}!
welcomeEmbed.description: You are our **{server.member_count.ordinal}** member. Enjoy your stay!

embed.title: 🛡️ Verification required
embed.description:
Welcome to **{server}**!

To make sure you are human, press **Verify** below. Once you pass, you get access to the rest of the server.

footer.text: Only you can see your captcha.

badWords.label: Bad Words
badWords.description: Removes messages that contain a listed word, phrase or pattern.

repeatedText.label: Repeated Text
repeatedText.description: Catches the same message sent over and over.

invites.label: Server Invites
invites.description: Catches invite links to other Discord servers.

links.label: External Links
links.description: Catches links that are blocked, or not allowed when no domain is blocked.

caps.label: Excessive Caps

threshold.unit: % capitals, messages with at least 10 letters

caps.description: Catches messages that are mostly capital letters.

emojis.label: Excessive Emojis
emojis.description: Catches messages with too many emojis.

spoilers.label: Excessive Spoilers
spoilers.description: Catches messages with too many spoiler tags or spoiler attachments.

mentions.label: Excessive Mentions
mentions.description: Catches messages that ping too many members or roles.

zalgo.label: Zalgo
zalgo.description: Catches glitch text with piles of combining marks.

spam.label: Anti-Spam
spam.description: Catches members who send messages too fast.
